{{Quote|We don't have much time. Let's take this moment to honor him, then we must move on. He would have wanted us to complete our mission.|Obi-Wan Kenobi at Piell's funeral|<ref name="Citadel Rescue">{{TCW|Citadel Rescue}}</ref>}}
During the escape from the prison known as The [[Citadel/Legends|Citadel]], [[Warden/Legends|Warden]] [[Osi Sobeck/Legends|Osi Sobeck]] released a pack of [[Anooba/Legends|anooba]] to track down the fugitives. During the anooba attack, one severely injured [[Even Piell/Legends|Even Piell]]. Before he died, he was able to give the [[Nexus Route/Legends|Nexus Route]] information to [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]. Ahsoka brought back Piell's dead body and the surviving members of the team, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]], [[Cody/Legends|CC-2224]], [[Fives/Legends|ARC-5555]], Ahsoka, [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]], [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and two of Piell's [[Clone navigation officer/Legends|naval officers]] held a '''funeral''' for him on the planet of [[Lola Sayu/Legends|Lola Sayu]] where Anakin and Obi-Wan used the Force to put his corpse into one of the streams of lava and watched until it disappeared.
